protocol.ranking: No new ranking/selection/classification; fixed five baselines only.
protocol.drawdown: Includes initial NAV=1; worst MDD means the most negative of lag0/1/2 closing-NAV drawdowns.
protocol.concentration: Actual close NAV weights including cash, not target weights; lag1 shown.
protocol.mixture: Initial 50/50 #239120 and H6e in two accounts, no later inter-account transfers; sleeve NAV proportions drift.
protocol.trading_days: Days with actual turnover >1e-10 NAV. Individual counts cross-checked by reconstructing fractional shares from held close weights/NAV/close prices; mixture count is union of either account trading, without inter-account netting.
protocol.benchmark: Independent bundle Close buy-and-hold, zero costs, no dividend adjustment, KRW; Jan2 and Jan5 entry bases kept separate. ETF KRX close and US stock close valuation times differ.
protocol.benchmark_calendar: Primary benchmark history uses original bundle189-date union calendar. A separate182-US-date sample is included to show calendar sampling effects on MDD.
